subject: reactiveFileReader Not reacting to file changes

messages.author: 97ea7b15c80564b8
messages.subject: reactiveFileReader Not reacting to file changes
parts:
I am writing text to file using a python script called from my server.R file and then trying to print the text every time the file changes, but Shiny is only recognizing that the file changed when my Python script has finished.  Is there a way to fix this?  

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 3d4089ca57dd0edf
messages.subject: Re: reactiveFileReader Not reacting to file changes
parts:
In R, I was calling python with system('python ...')
But the subsequent lines in R is not executed until the system() command has finished! So the reactiveFileReader was not being activated until the python program had finished running. But if you use system('python myfile.py',wait=FALSE), R will not wait for the system command to finish, and reactiveFileReader works as expected. 

It's soooo obvious :)
